description: This file defines a mock class 'GstGenericPlayerPrivateMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'IGstGenericPlayerPrivate'. It uses Google Mock to mock various methods related to media pipeline handling, such as scheduling media data, updating caps, changing pipeline state, and attaching media data.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerPrivateMock
classes.description: A mock class for IGstGenericPlayerPrivate used in unit testing to simulate media pipeline behaviors.

methods.name: scheduleNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mocks scheduling of media data need for a given GstAppSrc source.

methods.name: scheduleEnoughData
methods.description: Mocks scheduling when enough media data is available for a given GstAppSrc source.

methods.name: scheduleAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Mocks scheduling of audio underflow event.

methods.name: scheduleVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Mocks scheduling of video underflow event.

methods.name: scheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Mocks scheduling when all media sources are attached.

methods.name: setWesterossinkRectangle
methods.description: Mocks setting the rectangle for the Westerossink element.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mocks notification that media data is needed, specifying if audio or video notifications are needed.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.description: Mocks creation of a GstBuffer from a media segment.

methods.name: updateAudioCaps
methods.description: Mocks updating audio capabilities with sample rate, channels, and codec data.

methods.name: updateVideoCaps
methods.description: Mocks updating video capabilities with resolution, frame rate, and codec data.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Mocks changing the state of the media pipeline.

methods.name: startPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Mocks starting position reporting and underflow timer.

methods.name: stopPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Mocks stopping position reporting and underflow timer.

methods.name: setPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Mocks setting the pending playback rate.

methods.name: updatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Mocks updating the playback group with typefind element and caps.
